subject.title: fix(ui): give running tasks priority in the background-tasks rail

question: Should running tasks become the default visual priority in the chat background-tasks rail, with finished history initially collapsed and the tasks column widened for all existing users?
rationale: This is an intentional user-facing layout/default-policy change rather than a mechanically determined regression fix, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve the active-first default
options.body: Keep finished history collapsed initially, give running tasks the flexible space, and retain the wider tasks rail after refreshed merge checks pass.

options.title: Keep the existing presentation
options.body: Decline the default-layout change if completed history should remain equally prominent or the wider rail conflicts with the preferred workspace density.

recommendation.title: Approve the active-first default
recommendation.body: Keep finished history collapsed initially, give running tasks the flexible space, and retain the wider tasks rail after refreshed merge checks pass.
